record.question: Which permits/addenda cover the complete crossing itinerary?
record.reason: NPS ordinarily accepts the outside-origin agency permit; Hoover booking adds a specific south-of-CA120 permit/addendum condition. Preserve both instead of promising blanket reciprocity. Confirm itinerary, Donohue/Half Dome eligibility, any PCT permit, and Yosemite-bound issuance/no-self-issue restrictions.
